$comment: Health Class brand tokens: the single source. The app reads them in www/css/look.css (--hc-*), the website in app/globals.css (--rose, --plum...). Run `node brand/check-tokens.cjs` in this repo to see if the app drifted. The website keeps a synced copy in its own brand/ folder (scripts/check-brand.mjs).

ink.use: text, and shadows at low alpha

rose.use: the logo and large text only (3.8:1 with white)

roseInk.use: every button, the next action (5.4:1 with white)

roseDark.use: pressed or off button on a rose tint (5.2:1)

plum.use: structure: icons, eyebrows, links, done and chosen marks

plumDeep.use: the cat's line, footers, deep ink

sky.use: balance: one calm shape per screen

sky2.use: micro update marks, a water or fluid in drawings

colorRule: Rose and plum carry the brand, sky balances. No yellow, lavender, green, peach or tan, drawings included. One exception: the urine-color drawing (week 4 of Bladder leaks) keeps 4 real yellows, because the color is the medical advice.

app.title: Fraunces
app.note: bundled in the app; titles 34, 30, 26, 22, 19 px; text 17, 15, 13 px. Store image headlines: Fraunces Light.

site.title: Playfair Display
site.note: Editorial across the whole site. Source Sans with lining numerals. Caveat only for sketch labels and Dr. Kivlin's signature.

motion.press: scale to .96 in 90 ms, back in 420 ms on a spring
motion.enter: rise 22 px on a spring, 40 ms apart
motion.cat: 6 frames at 7 per second while on screen; frame 1 only under reduced motion
